description: Postprocessing change information aligned with OAS PostProcessingInformation.

message.description: Description of the post-processing change that was applied.

field.description: Name of the field that was changed during post-processing.

oldValue.description: Original value of the field before post-processing changes were applied. Null if the field was not previously set.

newValue.description: New value of the field after post-processing changes were applied. Null if the field was removed or not set.
